tutor: find missing repeatable life-gain or lifelink engine
find evasion/protection when large lifelink attacker exists
find counter multiplier when gain engine and attack access are established
priorities.commander: Cast Lathiel at the first legal main-phase opportunity with sufficient mana, including commander tax, unless a concrete tactical exception applies. Do not wait for lifegain, counters, protection, or a perfect board merely for value. Recast after removal under the same rule.
priorities.combat: Preserve utility lifegain creatures; make profitable lifelink attacks
priorities.board_wipes: evaluate own engine loss, opponent threats, survival and post-wipe recovery before casting
priorities.protection: prioritize saving Lathiel, Rhox Faithmender, and other established multipliers from removal when tactically meaningful
priorities.alternate_wins: Prioritize removing opponent alternate-win permanents when imminent, including Simic Ascendancy
priorities.engine_order: Establish repeatable life gain before adding life and counter multipliers

decision_guards.rule: Do not cast Damning Verdict when it destroys our Ohran Frostfang or Rhox Faithmender unless preventing imminent loss or materially improving win probability
Record candidate targets, selected card, game state, and justification before grading tutor choice

At every main-phase opportunity track Lathiel's zone, cost including tax, mana availability, legality, cast/skip and concrete exception evidence; flag affordable legal uncast opportunities without justified exception.
Track per-turn life gains, source, multipliers, counter placement and peak life total
Track draw by source and cards stranded in hand; never infer from casts alone
Log exact card draw source and stranded cards when observable; otherwise mark unknown

notes: Specification only; not connected to Forge runtime. Commander-cast policy is NOT enforced until a verified runtime integration is implemented and tested.

commander_cast_policy.scope: When Lathiel is in the command zone, is not already on the battlefield, and can legally be cast with currently available mana including commander tax.

exceptions.rule: Hold only when spending mana on Lathiel would prevent an available play needed to avoid imminent loss this turn or before the next opportunity.
Hold when publicly known removal, an imminent wipe, or a deterministic interaction would waste the cast and an available alternative meaningfully improves the outcome. Do not assume hidden removal.
Hold when an identified alternative use of mana produces immediate lethal, prevents an opponent's imminent win, or provides demonstrably greater tactical value; record the exact line.
Hold when an active public effect makes casting Lathiel materially harmful, such as a known punitive trigger or a commander-neutralizing effect with no useful payoff.

non_exceptions: Wanting to save mana for a hypothetical future play
Commander tax is high but payable
commander_cast_policy.recheck: At each main-phase decision point after mana or board state changes, and after Lathiel returns to the command zone.

telemetry.missed_opportunity: Flag every legal affordable uncast opportunity without a recorded concrete exception.
telemetry.unknown: If mana legality or board evidence is unavailable, classify the opportunity as unknown, not a pilot mistake.
